description: Start tracking an activity by type name (fuzzy matched, see list_activity_types) or type_id. Optionally backdate the start with `at` (wall-clock) or started_minutes_ago.

at.description: Backdate: start time as "HH:mm" (today) or "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm" in the user's timezone

started_minutes_ago.description: Backdate the start by N minutes (alternative to `at`)

timezone.description: IANA timezone `at` is given in (default: user's timezone)

type_id.description: Exact activity type id from list_activity_types (internal — never show ids to the user)

name: start_activity
